title: Sicilian Defense: Rossolimo Attack
line: White's bishop pins the knight and may trade itself for it; Black gets two bishops and open lines.

steps.text: Here White's bishop comes to b5 before the center opens. It eyes your knight.
Push the pawn on g7 one square. Your bishop will go to the long diagonal.

also.e7e6: That is also played. This lesson goes on with the bishop.

steps.after: White trades the bishop for your knight.

steps.text: Take back with the pawn on d7. It opens lines for your queen and your other bishop.

also.b7c6: That works too, and it heads toward the center. This lesson takes with the other pawn.

steps.text: Castle. Your king goes to safety, and a rook comes toward the center.
White's bishop hits your pawn on c5. Push the pawn on b7 one square to guard it.
steps.after: The pawn on c5 is guarded, and Black has two bishops against White's one.

summary: When White trades a bishop for the knight, Black takes back toward open lines and enjoys two bishops.
